title: research.completed
description: PAYLOAD of the `research.completed` envelope. Topic: campaign.research.completed. Emitted by the Synthesizer at the end of the ResearchWarRoom (§9.2-9.3) once the Campaign Intelligence Brief (CIB) is assembled and all agent outputs are schema-validated. Downstream (strategy-compiler §9.9) consumes this. The CIB body itself is the frozen artifact campaign_intelligence_brief.schema.json (§9.3); this event carries the reference + a thin summary so consumers can route without loading the full brief.

cib_id.description: Id of the produced Campaign Intelligence Brief (matches cib_id in campaign_intelligence_brief.schema.json).

cib_version.description: Version of THIS CIB (CIBs are versioned & diffable §9.3; a re-run mints a new version).

cib_ref.description: Pointer to the full CIB artifact (object-store URI or knowledge-service id). The full brief validates against campaign_intelligence_brief.schema.json.

summary.description: Thin routing summary so consumers/the dashboard avoid loading the whole brief.

north_star.description: Always CPqL in Phase 0/1 (§8.5 north star).

target_cpql_minor.description: Margin-derived target CPqL in INR paise (§13.4 target = margin x close_rate x safety).

min_distinct_concepts.description: Diversity floor from the matrix (§9.3 default 8).

agents_ran.description: Which War Room agents produced output for this brief (provenance / cost accounting). Phase-1 mini war room = Business, Persona, Offer, Compliance (§21).

evidence_count.description: Number of evidence claims attached to the CIB (every claim carries evidence+confidence §9.3).
